pr_title: usb: fix for parallel transfer deadlock with usb_transfer_sync()
pr_body:
Transfer status was not checked when accessing to transfer from endpoint callback. Adding status check, to prevent double complete. Double complete will cause deadlock when ongoing transfer complete callback is not called.

Fixes #30736

issue_context.title: Deadlock with usb_transfer_sync()
comments:
@ktolonen yes usb_transfers were not made to handle multiple transfers for the same endpoint simultaneously.
Please go ahead and submit PR.

review_comments: The whole thing around the transfer system is not designed to handle more than one transfer for specific endpoint. If an endpoint is used by two different contexts, then it should be checked with `usb_transfer_is_busy()`  before. I see API docu does not describe it. IMO, your change does not fix that and helps only if the transfers are not larger than endpoint MPS. I do not see any disadvantages of the patch yet, but commit message should be changed. I will block it for now.

I see... maybe this check could be in `usb_transfer_sync()` to prevent starting of parallel transfers to the same endpoint. Caller can implement the waiting logic based on `usb_transfer_is_busy()`, but if is it not done, the deadlock is hard to find without explicit error message. If API is changed then `samples/net/wpanusb/src/wpanusb.c` shall be updated accordingly since it does parallel transfers to same endpoint.
Updated commit with a check to prevent starting of the parallel transfers on same endpoint.
